1. (Currently amended) A cosmetic composition comprising:
a) an active ingredient which is a compound of formula I:
[[PNG media_image1.png 62 187 media_image1.png Greyscale]]
__wherein R1 is methoxy, R2 and R3 are each methyl, R4 is hydrogen, R5 is methyl, and R6 is carboxylic acid,__
and/or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof; and
b) one or more cosmetically acceptable vehicles.

2. (Previously presented) Composition according to Claim 1 wherein the compound of formula I is 5-(7-methoxy-3,3-dimethyl-2,3-dihydro-1-benzoxepin-5-yl)-3-methyl-penta-2,4-dienoic and/or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof.

3. (Currently amended) Composition for topical use comprising:
a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1 or 2,
b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and
c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action,
__wherein said composition is for cosmetic treatment of skin conditions.__

4. (Currently amended) Composition according to one or more of Claims 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0.00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight __for cosmetic skin care applications__.

5. (Previously presented) Composition according to claim 5, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine, preferably in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight, more preferably 0.1 to 5 per cent by weight and especially 0.1 to 2 per cent by weight.

7. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition __for topical skin care__.

8. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the preparation of a cosmetic composition which is suitable for the __cosmetic treatment__ of skin __conditions__ which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation, __including__ acne vulgaris, acne comedonica, polymorphic acne, acne rosaceae, nodular acne, acne conglobata, age-related acne, acne occurring as a side effect, such as acne solaris, medicament-related acne or acne professionalis, __and__ other defects of keratinisation, __including__ ichthyosis, ichthyosiform states, Darier's disease, keratosis palmo-plantaris, leukoplakia, leukoplakiform states, skin and mucosal (buccal) eczema (lichen), __and__ other skin __conditions__ which are associated with defective keratinisation and have an inflammatory and/or immunoallergic component, __including__ all forms of psoriasis relating to the skin, mucous membranes and finger- and toenails, and psoriatic rheumatism and skin atopy, such as eczema, or respiratory atopy, or also hypertrophy of the gums.

9. (Currently amended) Use according to Claim 8 for __cosmetic__ hair care and/or hair follicle __treatment__.

10. (Currently amended) Use __of__ the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the __cosmetic__ care, preservation or improvement of the general state of the skin or hair.

12. (Currently amended) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 or 2 for __cosmetic__ skin lightening and/or skin whitening.

13. (Currently amended) Use __of__ the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the __cosmetic treatment for reduction__ of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin.

14. (Currently amended) Use __of__ the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the __cosmetic treatment against__ time- and/or light-induced ageing processes of the human skin or human hair, __including cosmetic treatment against__ dry skin, wrinkle formation and/or pigment defects, and/or for the reduction __of__ the __cosmetic__ effects of UV rays on the skin.
